title: Ideas, in a few lines.
intro: Small, working patterns using the syntax supported by Qbits 1.0.1.

sections.title: A reactive counter
sections.body: State belongs to the component instance. Click to update it; only dependent bindings need to change.
sections.code:
component Counter:
    count = 0
    button text="Count: " + str(count):
        on click:
            count = count + 1

sections.title: A personal greeting
sections.body: Bind an input to a typed string. Qbits keeps the input and its focus in place while updating the greeting.
sections.code:
component Greeting:
    name = ""
    section:
        input:
            value=name
            on input:
                name = event.value
        p text="Hello, " + name

sections.title: Show what matters
sections.body: Use a boolean condition to choose a branch. Qbits handles preparation and disposal of the resulting interface.
sections.code:
component Details:
    expanded = false
    section:
        button text="Show details":
            on click:
                expanded = true
        if expanded:
            p text="Less code. More possibility."

sections.title: Connect components
sections.body: Typed child events let a parent respond to a child's intent. A named event can carry one string, number or boolean value.
sections.code:
component SaveButton:
    button text="Save":
        on click:
            emit saved("Ready")
